injuryReport.name: Steve Avila
injuryReport.beatComment: The Rams' left guard was injured in Week 9 against the Commanders and will miss a second straight game. Bill Murray or Justin Dedich (undisclosed) projects to start in Avila's place versus Green Bay.

injuryReport.name: Coleman Shelton
injuryReport.beatComment: The starting center is set to miss 4-6 weeks with a hamstring injury. Shelton will likely be placed on injured reserve while he recovers. Dylan McMahon (knee, IR) also sustained an injury in the Rams' Week 10 win over the Cardinals, leaving Beaux Limmer to finish out the contest at center and to likely fill in as the starter for the foreseeable future.

injuryReport.name: Kyren Williams
injuryReport.beatComment: Head coach Sean McVay relayed to Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com on Saturday that Williams is dealing with a sore toe, so his practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep aren't a surprise. Williams will have two more chances to put himself in a position to avoid a designation for Wednesday's game against the Packers.

injuryReport.name: Kam Curl
injuryReport.beatComment: Curl played through the issue last week against the Cardinals and should be fine for Wednesday's game against the Packers assuming he didn't suffer any setbacks versus Arizona. Curl has started all 10 games this season, recording 48 tackles (28 solo) and three pass breakups.

injuryReport.name: Myles Garrett
injuryReport.beatComment: With the Rams playing the Packers on Wednesday, the team was required to release an injury report Sunday. Garrett is in no danger of missing Week 12. He has 3.0 sacks and a forced fumble across three games this season.

irReserve.name: Davante Adams
irReserve.beatComment: The Rams have seemingly discounted the possibility of Adams coming off IR for a Wednesday matchup with the Packers in Week 12, while a Week 13 return is more plausible but still sounds like a "long shot," according to Rapoport. Instead, the Rams' Week 14 game against the 49ers on Dec. 13 would appear to be the most realistic target for Adams' return, especially since Los Angeles will effectively have a "mini-bye" ahead of that contest following its Thursday night matchup with Kansas City on Dec. 3. Whenever he's reinstated from IR, Adams should be in store for heavy target shares in the Rams' remaining games after star wideout Puka Nacua (knee) underwent season-ending MCL surgery earlier this week.

irReserve.name: Puka Nacua
irReserve.beatComment: Nacua is also dealing with a PCL sprain and turf toe, but the only procedure he required was for his MCL. With a firmer 4-to-5-month timeline now in place for the star wideout, he'll be done for the season while the Rams look to others to help fill the massive void in their receiver corps. Davante Adams (hamstring) should eventually take on a heavy target share, but he's also on injured reserve and isn't expected to return until at least Week 13. That leaves Konata Mumpfield, CJ Daniels, Tutu Atwell and Xavier Smith as the current healthy wideouts on the team's 53-man roster ahead of next Wednesday's tilt versus the Packers. Nacua, who is in the final year of his rookie deal, is slated to become a free agent in March.

irReserve.name: Justin Dedich
irReserve.beatComment: Dedich opened the regular season on injured reserve due to an undisclosed injury. He's now been cleared to practice, and his participation over the next few days will factor into whether he's activated from IR ahead of Wednesday's game against Green Bay.

irReserve.name: Kobie Turner
irReserve.beatComment: Turner has missed the Rams' last four games while on injured reserve due to a groin injury that he sustained in Week 6 against the Cardinals. His practice participation over the coming days will ultimately determine whether he'll be activated from IR ahead of Wednesday's game against the Packers.

irReserve.name: Terrance Ferguson
irReserve.beatComment: Even if Ferguson is moved back to the active roster, coach Sean McVay's comments indicate the tight end still won't be ready to play coming out of the team's Week 11 bye. His activation at least would keep him off season-ending IR, but his near-term availability remains uncertain until the Rams signal he's ready for game action. With Puka Nacua (knee/toe) likely done for the remainder of the regular season following MCL surgery, Ferguson and Davante Adams (hamstring) are needed badly in this offense.

irReserve.name: Dylan McMahon
irReserve.beatComment: McMahon suffered a knee injury during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. The injury is severe enough for McMahon to require a stint on IR, so he'll be required to miss at least the next four games, with his next chance to play being Week 16 against the Seahawks on Christmas Day. With Coleman Shelton nursing a hamstring injury, the Rams may have to turn to other options like David Quessenberry or Beaux Limmer to fill in at center for the time being.

coachingMatchup.headline: Matt LaFleur & DC Jonathan Gannon vs. HC Sean McVay & DC Chris Shula (Road Test)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting Green Bay Packers's staff (Matt LaFleur, OC Adam Stenavich, DC Jonathan Gannon) against Los Angeles Rams (6-4)—testing both Green Bay's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Matt LaFleur and OC Adam Stenavich look to stress Los Angeles Rams's single-high vs. two-high rotations with pre-snap motion, spacing, and play-action timing, while Los Angeles Rams's defensive front and coverage disguises aim to compress intermediate throwing windows.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: DC Jonathan Gannon balances pass-rush pressure with two-high/split-safety discipline on early downs, while Los Angeles Rams's offense tests Green Bay's edge containment, third-down execution, and red-zone stops.
